summary: Event store integrity validation — verifies append-only guarantees, sequence monotonicity, hash consistency, and stream integrity.

validations.name: append_only_writes
validations.description: FileEventStore uses open(path, 'a') exclusively — never truncates, never overwrites
validations.detail: All writes are append-only. Existing event lines remain unchanged after subsequent writes.

validations.name: monotonic_sequences
validations.description: Event sequences within a stream are strictly monotonic (0, 1, 2, ...)

validations.name: parent_chain_integrity
validations.description: parent_event_id forms an unbroken chain linking each event to its predecessor

validations.name: hash_consistency
validations.description: Stored deterministic_hash matches recomputed hash for each event

validations.name: valid_event_types
validations.description: All events use one of the 12 closed-set EventType values

validations.name: stream_termination
validations.description: Non-empty streams end with a terminal event (completed/failed/crashed)

validations.name: corruption_detection
validations.description: validate_event_stream detects gaps, wrong start types, and missing terminals
